title: EnergySystems LoadForecastCSV

stats.done_summary:
Task completed successfully. Analysis of 15-minute load data (Jan 1-7, 2026) produced:

**Deliverables:**
- Analysis code: code/analyze_load.py
- 7 figures in report/images/ (time series, daily profile, weekly pattern, distribution, duration curve, monthly, ramp rates)
- Comprehensive report: report/report.md

**Key Findings:**
- Mean load: 119.4 MW, Peak: 133.6 MW
- Annual energy estimate: 1,046 GWh
- Load factor: 89.4% (high, indicating stable demand)
- Required capacity (15% reserve): 153.6 MW
- Max ramp rates: ±85 MW/hour
- 90th/95th/99th percentile thresholds: 125.5/127.4/131.0 MW

The report provides methodology, results with figures, reliability metrics, and operational recommendations suitable for power system operations review.
